title: Base Encapsulated Interface Transport variant 5
purpose: Exercise a minimal, boundary-adjacent Modbus/TCP ADU for the device-identification form of Encapsulated Interface Transport.
expected_behavior: A conforming server may parse the function-43 MEI type-0e request and return basic device-identification objects, or return a standard exception if the MEI service is unsupported.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0005 equals the unit identifier plus the 4-byte PDU.
Function code 2b, MEI type 0e, read-device-identification code 01, and initial object identifier 00 are ordered consistently.
The compact request retains a valid-looking minimum payload shape.
issue_safety_notes: No external vulnerability or issue knowledge is available. This is a boundary-adjacent length candidate based on model-prior plausibility and should be treated as unverified.
